EXT. - EIKEN-RUBENDALL RESEARCH EXPEDITION PLANE

A sleek ultramodern aircraft is winging its way over Arctic waters toward a smoldering volcanic cone.  A U.S. Military cargo craft is escorting it, as is LEGACY, flying under his own power.

INT. - EIKEN-RUBENDALL RESEARCH EXPEDITION PLANE

A pretty black-haired teenager is staring out the window at the majestic, square-jawed, white-clad and caped figure of LEGACY, her expression one of absolute boredom.

LILIAN CORVUS:  "So lame...."

Camera cuts back to TACHYON, who seems to be controlling the urge to grind her teeth, and ABSOLUTE ZERO, whose body language conveys a mixture of confusion, contrition, and defensiveness.

TACHYON (quiet):  "I can't believe you let my bratty cousin Lilian on board an official exploratory flight to an island where drone reconaissance has spotted living pterodactyls.  What the hell were you thinking?"

ABSOLUTE ZERO:  "She said you approved it?  How was I supposed to know?  You've done crazier things."

TACHYON (less quiet):  "She's sixteen years old!  And if anything happens to her, Sergeant Corvus is going to have my head mounted on his wall next to all those African animals he kills for fun."

ABSOLUTE ZERO:  "We have three other superheroes along on this little eleventh-hour joyride to Sir Arthur Conan Doyle World, to say nothing of a hundred thousand dollars worth of equipment, not counting the Bunker suit, my own ambulatory prison and ICU, or any of Wraith's high-tech toys.  Even if there really are dinosaurs on this mysterious 'geothermal refuge', I doubt that your cuz would be any safer back at an inner-city public school."

TYLER VANCE (entering frame from left):  "Besides, Lily's a good kid, even if she is going through the whole teenage angst phase.  I think she just wanted to spend some time with her famous nuclear physicist slash superhero relative?"

ABSOLUTE ZERO:  "Then why's she sulking in the forward compartment?"

TACHYON:  "She's always sulking.  It's her default setting."

TYLER VANCE:  "She's probably just not a people person."

ABSOLUTE ZERO:  "That's what you think.  Believe me, I know loneliness.  She may quote awful Goth poetry at the drop of a hat, but she's not really depressed; she just likes to make a show of it.  She'd probably have a whole flock of admirers back at her school if she wanted one, but she gets off on pretending to hate everyone.  Not that I knew any of this when she showed up at the lab claiming to be your intern."

TACHYON:  "I still can't believe you fell for that."

INTERCOM:  "Attention everyone, this is your captain speaking...we are now ten minutes from landing on an uncharted island twenty kilometers above the Arctic Circle, where volcanic activity and an anomalous wind pattern result in a tropical climate year-round despite the high latitude.  Please fasten your seat belts as we prepare to make a water landing just off the coast."

An uncomfortable expression settles on TACHYON's face as she straps in, while TYLER VANCE looks relaxed and cheerful as usual.  AZ goes into the forward compartment and can be faintly heard arguing with LILIAN, who claims that seat belts are "merely a feeble attempt at preserving an illusion of safety in the face of the constant threat of man's utter annihilation by the uncaring cosmos".  Eventually he must manage to assert some authority and get the issue resolved, for he comes back and buckles himself in as well.

EXT - COAST OF INSULA PRIMALIS

The seaplane sets down onshore, while the Army craft powers along, dropping several crates as it flies over the island.  THE WRAITH can be seen clinging to the parachute straps of the largest one.  Legacy swoops in and offers her a gentlemanly hand getting down, even as the boat containing the other four arrives on shore.

Sorry it took me so long to get back here and update you guys.

Welcome to the game, Humble-Knight! And thank you for not playing an Adhesive Foam Grenade on the first turn, forcing me to figure out what that means in a game where the Environment and Villain decks are reversed (if played as normally affecting the Enviro deck, it'd mean this would be an extremely dull second round).

jffdougan:

For portability reasons, I'd been running the deck by spreadsheet. Should be pretty easy to move things around in a way that mimics shuffling cards in trash, play, and hand.



The cards you haven't yet seen ought to be random and unknown to you…I'm not too comfortable with you just copy-pasting card named among spreadsheet fields at whim.  Even if you are trying not to pay attention, the brain has a habit of imprinting random facts, so you might know that you have a Thermal Shockwave coming up three cards from now and then forget that you knew, so you never fix the problem, but your play is shaped by subconscious realization of your destiny.  If you can't keep a deck on hand to shuffle, perhaps carry a couple d20s in your pocket, and whenever you need to draw a random card, roll them - one is the 20s digit, the other just goes odd-even to determine whether you add 20 to the total, and whenever you roll a number higher than the current count of your deck (including any bottomed cards), you reroll.  (This might bias the roll result slightly against numbers above 20, but eventually the deck will be down to 20 cards and you can stop doing the odd-even roll, so the problem will fix itself.)

dpt:

I took my hand and trash, shuffled them, and put them on the bottom of my deck.

Again, you shouldn't know the order of the shuffled cards, so your deck should actually look like this:

Deck: (randomly ordered group of: The Legacy Ring, Flying Smash, Take Down, Fortitude, Danger Sense x2) - (randomly ordered group of: Back-Fist Strike, Superhuman Durability x2, Lead from the Front x3, Inspiring Presence x2, Fortitude x2, Bolster Allies x3, "Thokk!" x2, Next Evolution x2, Surge of Strength x3, Flying Smash, Motivational Charge, Heroic Interception, Take Down, The Legacy Ring, Heroic Interception) - Motivational Charge - Back-Fist Strike - Heroic Interception

I am inclined to be suspicious of Wraith's triple-Impromptu hand, but I have literally seen the same thing happen in the last two non-solo games I played (both of which featured Wraith, while the solo game in between did not).  It was likely the result of bad shuffling, but even so, it can happen, so I'll assume that Oaktree is "lucky" rather than "cheating".  So much for this game being anything resembling a challenge…

EXT - INSULA PRIMALIS

As the five intrepid superhumans (well, three superhumans and two extremely above-average "normal" humans each possessing millions of dollars worth of sophisticated gadgetry) - and, behind them, one morbid teenager - move forward across the jagged volcanic plain, they begin to notice large rotting carcasses piled on all sides, thronged with crows and vultures feasting on their entrails.  TACHYON zooms from one decayed hulk to the next, jabbering excitedly as she streaks across the dogged marching line of the other five visitors.

TACHYON (most intelligible snippet of garbled non-stop dialogue):  "…mygodit'sreallytruethesearetotallyLIVINGDINOSAURSwellokaynotlivinganymoreBUTtheywereuntilrecently, looksliketheymusthavebeencaughtbyablastofcarbonmonoxidegaswhenavolcanicventerupted, couldn'thavehappenedmorethansixhoursagoit'stoobadwehadtoapproachfromthesouthorwe'dhavegottenaniceview, hopefullythesamethingdoesn'thappenagainwhilewe'rehereit'dtotallysuckifwehadtoevacuate, wonderifIshouldtakesomesamplesbutdamnIdidn'tbringtheproperdecontaminationgear, didn'treallythinkwe'dactuallyfindanythingLIVINGhere(assumingtheseweren'tallofthemandsomeactuallyarestillliving)…"

LILIAN CORVUS (sotto voce):  "ugh…she's always so damn eager about everything, even when she's not moving at lightspeed I get tired just listening to her babble all the time, like life is all just one big adventure…one of these days she'll wake up a lonely old woman and be all like 'what happened', and she just won't get it…why the hell did I want to come along with this merry-go-round…"

As she walks sullenly behind the heroes muttering to herself, LILIAN looks about at the spectacle of death, with a mixture of disgust and fascination on her face.  Every time a new bird takes flight within her field of vision, she follows its path with her eyes, a faint ghost of a smile on her face - until she catches ABSOLUTE ZERO's faceplate turned her way, and forcibly stiffens her face into a mask of disdainful grumpiness.

EXT - FOREST CLEARING

In a dark and shadowy spot among the trees, LILIAN has paused in her flight from the scene of battle, sitting with her back against a massive cycad and listening to the distant sounds of combat.  She does not see as a seven-pointed shape, identical to the one that appeared in the sky, draws itself in midair off to one side of her and a black-robed figure steps forth, tall but slightly hunched, as if his shoulders were too big for his neck.  The STRANGER abruptly speaks.

STRANGER:  "Pathetic fools, aren't they?"

LILIAN whirls about in shock, stumbling to her feet and backing away.  As when she was scared before, however, she doesn't utter a sound, not wanting her solicitous cousin to come running.

STRANGER:  "Be at ease, child.  I mean you no harm...quite the opposite, indeed."

LILIAN:  "How did you get here?  Who are you?"

STRANGER:  "Do these things matter?  It's not important.  What you need to know is that I sensed your power as soon as you came to this primeval place.  You have a very old soul, and this is a refuge for things from an earlier, more glorious age.  A time before self-righteous meddlers and meaningless laws; a time when you could look up at the stars and feel truly alive.  A part of you remembers such times, doesn't it?  Longs for them?  But more, longs to be powerful, meaningful, not just one face lost in a crowd of teeming imbeciles, but a being of majesty and grace, ruling over the wild things of the world.  Do you not feel so?"

LILIAN (breathless):  "Wow...I didn't think anyone else 'got it'...."

STRANGER:  "Here.  Take this."  He hands LILIAN a smooth, black crystal, which she takes hesitantly.  "It is a relic of that older, purer time; it will reshape itself to suit your dreams, and grant you the ability to fulfill them.  Just gaze into the blackness within, and it will gaze into your own dark soul, see the beauty and glory within you, and bring them to life.  I must go, now, but I will find you again, after you have claimed your place as this world's ruling Matriarch."

LILIAN pays no attention to the STRANGER as he withdraws and fades into the darkness, her gaze fixed on the black crystal.  Camera zoom tightens on the crystal and her eyes in an overlapping effect, one image growing as the other shrinks; at the halfway point, they switch places, and as her eyes zoom back into view, a feathered mask adorns them, identical to a doodle she was sketching in her notebook back on the plane.

MATRIARCH:  "Yes...I see now.  The creatures of the air, the agents of Death...I envied them.  And now, my will can rule them all...."
